gen-fs-oswald-gf-stix-two-text: Oswald packs its lines into tight, tall columns with a confident, display-sized punch. And STIX Two Text, a text serif with barely any gap between thick and thin strokes, brings the quieter, editorial side.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Dignified is the first word that comes to mind for Tai Heritage Pro, whose round letters each get a clear channel leading in, under a heading from Oswald. Oswald stays compact and forceful above it.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-taviraj: Taviraj reads like a bookish text serif, with generous gaps where its curves end. Oswald's compact, confident strength against that medium-contrast softness is the best thing about the pairing.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-trirong: Oswald is built from tightly knit, strong rows that look confident even at a glance. But Trirong's softly flared curve ends and gentle stroke variation give the pair a bookish, dignified counterweight.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-trocchi: Trocchi opens its c like a wide-open ring, and its bowls thin gracefully rather than sharply. Trocchi as a text serif can take a generous size, while Oswald keeps the heading compact and strong.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-trykker: Tight and tall, then breathing out. Oswald's confident, compact rows sit above Trykker, a literary text serif whose open counters let the white space in, and its understated contrast is what makes the two feel so distinct.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-uchen: Oswald's tightly knit, confident rows are what you notice first in this pair. And Uchen, a serif with curves that welcome the eye, offers a restrained, refined midpoint beneath it.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-vollkorn-sc: Compact on top, loose below. Oswald holds its strong rows tight, but Vollkorn SC, a text serif with medium contrast and generously spaced letters, lets a longer stretch read in a literary, unhurried way.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-yuji-syuku: Oswald knits its letters into tight, confident rows that feel built for display, with real authority. Yuji Syuku, a classic serif, spaces everything openly and curves its strokes gently, keeping the body dignified.
